parsed.note_claim: The first plane strike was not broadcast live; it was captured by French filmmaker Jules Naudet while filming a documentary and aired later.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: while filming a documentary about the FDNY. The footage shot in 2001 was made into the 2002 documentary 9/11 .
parsed.reason: The page confirms Naudet captured the footage while filming a documentary and it was released in 2002, substantiating the claim it was not a live broadcast.
